messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick ask — we need final social execution for the ModelServe v1.2 launch. Goal: announce launch + drive webinar signups and inbound demos. Target publish window: Tue 10am PT for primary burst. Need: X thread (6 tweets), 2 LinkedIn posts (company + founder POV), 3 single-image X posts (short, punchy).

Jamal Reed: +1. Can we lock the CTA and the tracking UTM now? I want to set up the landing page so the form goes to the right SFDC queue.

Maria Liu: CTA should be: "See ModelServe 1.2 in action — register for the launch webinar". Use utm_campaign=msv1_2_launch and utm_source=social. Leads from LinkedIn -> SFDC queue: "MKT_LAUNCH_LINKEDIN". X replies -> route to "MKT_SOCIAL_INBOUND". APAC timezone leads: assign to apac-sdr-group.

Sara Patel: Design can deliver 3 hero images and a vertical for stories by EOD tomorrow. Need final copy for the image overlay and the 2 headline lengths (short 55 chars, long 140 chars).

Alex Gomez: Draft X thread (6 tweets) — posting suggestion below. Feedback welcome. (I'll own the thread copy + scheduling)

Alex Gomez: ```
Tweet 1: ModelServe v1.2 is live ⚡️ Faster kernels, smarter routing, and lower inference costs. Join our launch webinar to see it in action → [short link]
Tweet 2: Why it matters: production apps need predictable latency + cost. v1.2 gives teams new batching and KV cache optimizations to do just that.
Tweet 3: Performance highlights: 2–3x throughput on long-context workloads, 15–30% lower token cost with intelligent quantization.
Tweet 4: Built for ops: canary rollouts, per-route SLOs, and automatic fallback to cheaper model variants.
Tweet 5: Want the numbers? We'll share benchmark slides in the webinar + a public repo with test configs.
Tweet 6: Register now — limited spots for live Q&A: [webinar link] #ModelServe #LLMinfra #RedwoodInference
```

Olivia Chen: This reads great. Swap "2–3x" to "up to 3x" (legal) and add "APAC session" note in the final tweet. Also add founder POV LinkedIn draft.

Alex Gomez: Updated thread done. Will put the short link after final landing page is up.

Sara Patel: Quick Q on tone: should the company LinkedIn be product-forward, and founder post more narrative?

Olivia Chen: Yes — company: product + numbers. Founder: story about the ops pain and a short anecdote on how we built fallback routing. Keep both ~200–350 words max.

Jamal Reed: Scheduling plan: primary X thread + 2 single-image posts (day 0 morning + day 0 afternoon). LinkedIn company post on day 0 morning; founder post day 0 evening (to capture different windows). Boost the company post to target infra/product manager audiences for 48hrs.

Maria Liu: Lead routing recap: landing form -> SFDC web-to-lead with utm. Set lead owner to "MKT_QUAL" queue. SalesOps to auto-create task for "webinar - followup" with 24hr SLA. Social replies that include demo asks: auto-assign to social-ops Slack channel and create ticket in Zendesk tag: social-demo.

Olivia Chen: Engagement followups — need 3 short reply templates for social team. Drafts below, please flag edits.

Alex Gomez: Reply templates:
- Quick demo offer: "Thanks! We'd love to show you ModelServe 1.2 — can I DM you a link to pick a 15-min slot?"
- Webinar reminder DM: "Thanks for signing up — you’ll get a calendar invite shortly. Any specific topic you'd like us to cover?"
- Metrics/benchmark ask: "We’ll be sharing benchmark slides in the webinar. If you want early access, drop your email and we’ll send the deck."

Sara Patel: Got it. I'll put the CTA buttons on the hero images to match those CTAs.

CampaignBot: calendar event created: "ModelServe v1.2 social publish window" Tue 10:00 PT — attendees: marketing-team.

Olivia Chen: Can someone confirm copy chars for the LinkedIn company post? I'll paste draft here.

Olivia Chen: "Today we’re excited to launch ModelServe v1.2 — focused on predictable inference at scale. Teams deploying LLMs can now expect up to 3x throughput on long-context workloads and meaningful cost reductions through smarter batching and quantization. Join our launch webinar for a deep dive and real-world benchmarks. Register: [link]"

Jamal Reed: Fits. Suggest adding a short customer quote if we can get permission — turns it into social proof.

Maria Liu: Ops note: once landing page is live, tag posts with utm_content=company_post or utm_content=x_thread_t1 etc. We'll map to respective SFDC campaigns.

Sara Patel: Design will upload images to Figma: /ModelServe/LaunchAssets by EOD tomorrow and share variants (light/dark).

Alex Gomez: I'll queue the X thread in Buffer/Sprout and tag it "priority: launch". Will schedule 10:00 PT + 14:00 PT repost.

Olivia Chen: Awesome. Owners: Alex = social scheduling + thread, Sara = assets, Maria = lead routing + tracking, Jamal = landing page & links, Olivia = copy approvals. Please check off when done and update this thread. :thumbsup:

DesignBot: Files uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/example/modelserve-launch (mock link).

Maria Liu: Landing page form done & webhook -> SFDC queue. Short link ready: https://rwd.in/msv1-2 (placeholder).

Alex Gomez: Scheduled initial posts as draft. Will publish once Olivia gives final approval on copy and link.

Olivia Chen: Approved. Publish when this thread is closed and landing link is final. Thanks team! :rocket!
